title: Student Emergency Contact Permission Slip Form
subtitle: An original operational permission slip for student emergency contact that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Student Emergency Contact Permission Slip Form supports the complete student emergency contact workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Student Emergency Contact Permission Slip Form when the assigned student records coordinator needs one fillable record for student emergency contacts, contact priority, authorized disclosure, and response routing without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Emergency contact permission slip identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this permission slip to one student emergency contacts, contact priority, authorized disclosure, and response routing record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: Emergency contact record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: Emergency contact scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: Emergency contact requested participation and permission scope
sections.guidance: Separate each requested activity and condition so one choice does not imply another.

blocks.label: Emergency contact permission choices
items: Use of the listed contacts for the named school or program context
Contact priority and preferred communication channel
Emergency message sharing limited to necessary facts
Interpreter or accessibility support through an approved route
Alternate contact use when the primary route fails
Restrictions or do-not-use routes reviewed by authorized staff
Student release remains governed by the separate release record
Optional communication uses recorded separately from emergency routing
blocks.guidance: Each item is independent; document any exclusion or condition in the scope table.

blocks.label: Permission and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records student emergency-contact routing; it does not decide custody, prove legal authority, replace a child-release record, give medical direction, or delay emergency services. Use minimum necessary information, follow approved contact restrictions, and stop disclosure or release when identity or authority is unclear. Route disputes and professional decisions to authorized qualified reviewers.

sections.title: Emergency contact guardian routing, readiness, and support review
sections.guidance: Confirm contact, release, support, and stop conditions before relying on the permission record.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring review before participation
items: Student identity or contact record does not match
Primary and alternate contacts cannot be reached
Relationship, priority, or authority source is unclear
Contact direction conflicts with an approved restriction
Interpreter, accessibility, or alternate communication route is unavailable
Sensitive contact or student information was exposed
Immediate emergency response is active and contacts remain pending
Contact attempt, acknowledgment, or record update does not reconcile

blocks.label: Participation support, limitation, owner, and evidence
Guardian questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

fields.label: Questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

sections.title: Emergency contact permission decision and authorization
sections.guidance: Preserve approved, declined, conditional, and unresolved scope as separate decisions.

blocks.label: Emergency contact permission decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the school administrator, guardian, records custodian, and qualified emergency reviewer.

blocks.label: Decision rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

fields.label: Rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

sections.title: Emergency contact permission exceptions and operating handoff
sections.guidance: Do not force agreement; assign unresolved scope and communicate operating limits.

blocks.label: Permission exception and stop indicators
items: Student or contact identity cannot be confirmed
Primary and alternate contact attempts are unsuccessful
Authority, priority, restriction, or disclosure route is unclear
Private record, interpreter, or communication support is unavailable
Immediate emergency response is active
Contact acknowledgment, update, or record closeout remains unresolved

blocks.label: Exception, immediate control, owner, escalation, and disposition
Approved-scope handoff requirements
items: Approved and declined scope communicated to assigned staff
Conditions and stop points visible at the point of use
Guardian and qualified-review sources linked
Release, transport, or setting limits routed when applicable
Unresolved permission has an owner and due point
Completion evidence and record location identified

sections.title: Emergency contact outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Emergency contact closeout controls
items: Contact identity, priority, and verification status accepted
Guardian or alternate contact acknowledgment recorded
Unresolved restriction or failed-contact route has an owner
Private contact records returned to approved custody
Emergency, interpreter, or records follow-up linked
Contact record stored with access and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Permission Slip closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
